input.overview: On io-shop, the monthly spend totals stored for shoppers fell short of the purchases behind them. This lasted {duration}. After a new monthly-spend feature was switched on, the shop likely began recording each purchase without adding it to the shopper's stored total for the month. That meant the totals for shoppers who bought after the switch-on fell further behind with every purchase. Argus estimates the lost takings at {customer_loss}, and no one on call was paged. Argus suspected the new feature but chose not to switch it off itself, because nothing could confirm within the time Argus waits whether that would work. Instead, Argus recommends turning the monthly-spend feature off. Argus also drafted a proposed fix, but the draft has not been applied, so nothing it would change has happened yet.
